designationHistory.indexText: The Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved Chickasaw National Wildlife Refuge on the Mississippi River in west Tennessee to protect about 37,500 acres of bottomland hardwoods for migratory waterfowl.
designationHistory.note: FWS only. May 14, 1985 is the Commission's approval date; the date of first acquisition was not found.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Chickasaw NWR Comprehensive Conservation Plan, 2006 (ServCat 169400)
